svg.title: Test a code review finding
svg.desc: A finding is a possible problem in a proposed change. A small test helps a reviewer decide if it is real. Find the line. Open the code named in the review. Try the input. Run a case that would expose the problem. Record what happened. Test the fix. Repeat the case after the edit and save the result for the reviewer.
